judged_text: The migration dereferences execute(...)[0]['id'] on a query that returns zero rows on any install where the embed_category site setting was never changed from its default, raising NoMethodError on nil before the category_id == 0 fallback can run. db:migrate aborts with NoMethodError on fresh installs and on the majority of existing installs (Discourse only persists site settings that differ from their YAML default, and embed_category's default is ''), blocking every deploy and every new-install bootstrap; the `if category_id == 0` fallback on line 14 is dead code because the crash fires in exactly the missing-row case it was written to handle.
